descr: unos vecinos de 19 años me han preguntado en el portal por el aparato, por su funcionamiento y se lo he explicado.
descr_english: Some 19-year-old neighbors asked me in the doorway about the device and how it works, and I explained it to them.

descr: mis compañeros de trabajo me preguntaron por el aparato y la experiencia, y me comunicaron que les hubiera gustado participar.
descr_english: My work colleagues asked me about the device and the experience, and they told me they would have liked to participate.

descr: al salir a comer en el día de hoy, la gente en la calle y en el restaurante miraban con extrañeza pero ninguno se arrancó a preguntar
future_use: es raro que te mire la gente por la calle, pero a la vez es gracioso
descr_english: When I went out to for lunch today, people on the street and in the restaurant looked at me in a strange way, but none of them dared to ask.
future_use_english: It's strange when people look at you in the street, but it's also funny.
